feasibility.buildNote: cleanBuildSec and incrementalRebuildSec measure the single-tree freeze build; the evaluator builds candidate and reference trees in each eval
feasibility.evalSecNote: mean containerized eval wall across the two admission ordering passes (3922.5s and 3178.4s wall, 14 evals each) under ambient VM contention; includes the candidate plus in-eval reference harness builds and nine timed bench repetitions per phase per workload

measurement.benchSampling: per workload: pristine in-eval reference and candidate bench legs interleaved on the same trusted per-iteration parse-go token stream (one unpredictable 64-bit token per timed iteration, drawn by the trusted parent from the OS CSPRNG via secrets.token_bytes at repetition start, stored once, and replayed identically to both legs; never derived from enumerable fields, so no untimed-window precompute set exists), in per-repetition alternating leg order so time-monotone host drift within a repetition biases neither leg, one warm repetition each, then nine timed repetitions with each phase scored from summed per-iteration minima: every timed iteration index keeps its fastest window across the nine repetitions, identically for candidate and reference (per-leg multiplicative placement/frequency lotteries cancel in neither min-of-summed-phases nor median-of-per-pair-ratios -- both measured ~4% A-A spread on this host -- while summed per-iteration minima measured ~1.6%, giving every iteration nine independent chances at a calm scheduling window). The trusted Python parent owns the clock: per timed iteration it waits for the leg's ready marker, starts the clock as it releases a single opaque parse-go token, and stops the clock on the leg's receipt. The whole timed operation is derived from that token -- the per-iteration mutation is seeded by it, so mutation, parse and the tree-signature digest all run after the token arrives and inside the measured window, and the candidate-linked harness holds no clock to rewrite. The receipt folds the parse-go token with the completed tree's content-inclusive signature -- the full pre-order (symbol, start_byte, end_byte) walk plus, for every leaf node, a rolling FNV of the parsed buffer's source bytes in that leaf's range -- so no correct receipt can be produced before the token exists or without completing the parse inside the timed window, and a schedule variant whose class-preserving swaps all land in token interiors (leaving the tree structurally byte-identical to the pristine parse) still changes every touched leaf's content fold and therefore the receipt. The parent folds each leg's receipt stream into a per-phase accumulator that must equal the pristine reference run on the identical token stream. Each leg runs in a fresh IPC namespace with fresh /var/tmp and /dev/shm tmpfs, and the full candidate-uid process tree is reaped after every reference and candidate leg. Score is the frozen scale 50661657.83045164 times the geometric mean of the 12 per-cell reference/candidate summed-per-iteration-minimum time ratios. Every candidate timed iteration must additionally clear a plausibility floor of one tenth of the pristine reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration, rejecting near-zero measured windows, and every candidate bench leg must show out-of-process wait4-accounted CPU work of at least 0.4x the same repetition's pristine reference leg (kernel reaped-child accounting read by the trusted parent, never candidate-reported).
